articles.title: The Future of Artificial Intelligence
articles.description: How artificial intelligence is changing our everyday lives.
articles.content: Artificial intelligence is becoming an important part of modern technology. From voice assistants to autonomous systems, AI is changing many areas of our everyday lives. In the future, we can expect even more applications of artificial intelligence in medicine, education, transportation and business.
articles.author: Admin

comments.author: Anna
comments.text: Very interesting article about the future of AI!

comments.author: Max
comments.text: AI will definitely become more important in the future.

articles.title: React: Why Component-Based Development Matters
articles.description: An introduction to component-based development with React.
articles.content: React allows developers to build user interfaces from reusable components. Instead of creating one large application, developers can divide the interface into smaller and independent parts. This approach makes applications easier to maintain, test and expand.
articles.author: Admin

comments.author: Anna
comments.text: React components make large applications much easier to manage.

comments.author: Max
comments.text: Good introduction to component-based development.

articles.title: JavaScript Features Every Developer Should Know
articles.description: A look at useful modern JavaScript features.
articles.content: Modern JavaScript provides many powerful features that make development easier. Arrow functions, destructuring, modules, promises and async/await are now standard tools for frontend developers. Understanding these features is essential when building modern web applications.
articles.author: Admin

comments.author: Anna
comments.text: Async and await are some of my favorite JavaScript features.

comments.author: Max
comments.text: Destructuring makes JavaScript code much cleaner.

articles.title: How APIs Work in Modern Web Applications
articles.description: Understanding communication between frontend applications and servers.
articles.content: APIs allow different software applications to communicate with each other. In frontend development, APIs are commonly used to load and modify data from a server. The fetch API provides a simple way to make HTTP requests from a React application.
articles.author: Admin

comments.author: Anna
comments.text: The explanation of APIs is very clear.

comments.author: Max
comments.text: I use APIs in almost every project.

articles.title: Understanding HTTP Methods
articles.description: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE explained.
articles.content: HTTP methods define what action should be performed on a resource. GET is normally used to retrieve data, POST to create new data, PUT and PATCH to update data, and DELETE to remove data. Understanding these methods is important when working with REST APIs.
articles.author: Admin

comments.author: Anna
comments.text: PATCH is especially useful when updating only part of an object.

comments.author: Max
comments.text: A useful overview of HTTP methods.

articles.title: CSS Grid vs Flexbox
articles.description: When should you use CSS Grid and when should you use Flexbox?
articles.content: CSS Grid and Flexbox are two essential layout systems. Flexbox is especially useful for one-dimensional layouts, while Grid is designed for two-dimensional layouts. Understanding the differences allows developers to create responsive and flexible interfaces.
articles.author: Admin

comments.author: Anna
comments.text: I usually prefer Flexbox, but Grid is great for complex layouts.

comments.author: Max
comments.text: This helped me understand the difference between Grid and Flexbox.

articles.title: Responsive Web Design Basics
articles.description: How to make websites work well on different screen sizes.
articles.content: Responsive design ensures that a website works correctly on smartphones, tablets and desktop computers. Developers can use flexible layouts, media queries and responsive units to adapt the interface to different screen sizes.
articles.author: Admin

comments.author: Anna
comments.text: Responsive design is essential for modern websites.

comments.author: Max
comments.text: Media queries are really useful for responsive layouts.

articles.title: What Is Frontend Development?
articles.description: An introduction to the world of frontend development.
articles.content: Frontend development focuses on the part of a website or application that users interact with. HTML, CSS and JavaScript form the foundation of frontend development, while modern frameworks such as React provide tools for building complex interfaces.
articles.author: Admin

comments.author: Anna
comments.text: Frontend development is a very interesting field.

comments.author: Max
comments.text: HTML, CSS and JavaScript are a great foundation.

articles.title: Introduction to Git and GitHub
articles.description: Why version control is an essential skill for developers.
articles.content: Git is a distributed version control system that allows developers to track changes in their projects. GitHub provides a platform for storing Git repositories and collaborating with other developers. Both tools are commonly used in professional software development.
articles.author: Admin

comments.author: Anna
comments.text: Git is one of the first tools every developer should learn.

comments.author: Max
comments.text: Git makes working on projects much safer.

articles.title: Web Accessibility Basics
articles.description: How to make websites accessible to more people.
articles.content: Web accessibility means designing websites that can be used by people with different abilities. Semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, sufficient contrast and meaningful labels are some of the important principles of accessible web development.
articles.author: Admin

comments.author: Anna
comments.text: Accessibility is often overlooked but extremely important.

comments.author: Max
comments.text: Good article. Every website should consider accessibility.
